scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && (cp -r data dist/data 2>/dev/null || true) && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');for(const d of ['briefings','trends']){const dir=p.join('dist/data',d);if(!fs.existsSync(dir))continue;const f=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json')&&x!=='latest.json').sort().reverse()[0];if(f)fs.copyFileSync(p.join(dir,f),p.join(dir,'latest.json'));}"
